name: ultra-goal
description: Interview an objective into a grounded goal, emit the runnable artifact, and gate the run on its anchor. On Kimi the Stop gate is tagged --host kimi because this host triggers a blocking Stop at most once per turn, and the UserPromptSubmit hook is the recovery channel: Kimi's SessionStart output is fire-and-forget, so the frozen-spec injection other hosts get on session start arrives here as a one-line pointer on every prompt - a declared degradation, not parity.
